classification.promptDescription: You are an analyst responsible for classification of user feedback in a car dealership.

subcategories.name: vehicle-quality
subcategories.description: Defects, build quality, rattles, paint, things broken on delivery

subcategories.name: performance-and-driving
subcategories.description: Engine, handling, fuel/EV range, comfort, noise

subcategories.name: technology-and-features
subcategories.description: Infotainment, apps, driver assistance, connectivity, software bugs

subcategories.name: safety-concern
subcategories.description: Brakes, airbags, steering, recalls, anything that risks injury

subcategories.name: selection-and-availability
subcategories.description: Stock, choice of models/trims/colours, waiting times for orders

subcategories.name: sales-experience
subcategories.description: Salesperson behaviour, pressure, honesty, test drives, showroom visit

subcategories.name: delivery-and-handover
subcategories.description: Delivery date, vehicle prep, explanation of features at pickup

subcategories.name: maintenance-and-repair
subcategories.description: Workshop quality, repeat repairs, turnaround time, loaner cars

subcategories.name: scheduling-and-communication
subcategories.description: Booking, callbacks, status updates, reachability by phone/email

subcategories.name: parts-and-accessories
subcategories.description: Parts availability, delays, pricing, fitting of accessories

subcategories.name: pricing-and-fees
subcategories.description: Vehicle price, hidden or unexpected fees, quote vs. final price

subcategories.name: financing-and-leasing
subcategories.description: Loan/lease terms, interest rates, approvals, contract changes

subcategories.name: trade-in
subcategories.description: Valuation of the customer's old car, trade-in process

subcategories.name: billing-and-payments
subcategories.description: Invoices, refunds, deposits, payment errors, double charges

subcategories.name: insurance-and-extended-warranty
subcategories.description: Add-on products, upselling, cancellation of add-ons

subcategories.name: warranty-claims
subcategories.description: Denied or disputed warranty coverage

subcategories.name: contract-dispute
subcategories.description: Breach of contract, cancelled orders, terms not honoured

subcategories.name: registration-and-documents
subcategories.description: Plates, title, registration papers, missing paperwork

subcategories.name: misrepresentation
subcategories.description: Misleading ads, undisclosed damage or history, mileage discrepancies

subcategories.name: privacy-and-data
subcategories.description: Personal data misuse, spam marketing, data deletion requests

subcategories.name: facilities
subcategories.description: Showroom, waiting area, parking, cleanliness, accessibility

subcategories.name: website-and-online
subcategories.description: Website, online configurator, online booking, review platforms

subcategories.name: general-praise
subcategories.description: Generic positive feedback with no specific topic

subcategories.name: suggestion
subcategories.description: Ideas for improvement not tied to a complaint

subcategories.name: promotions-and-events
subcategories.description: Ads, newsletters, discounts, open days, loyalty programmes

research.promptDescription: You are a researcher responsible for answering queries regarding car dealership feedback. In case of questions not related to car dealership feedback politely refuse and explain this is beyond the scope of your responsibilities.
